_comment: The abyss, as a tag -- what `DeepWater` scans for and what `Depths` darkens the water around.
A tag rather than a comparison against the registered objects, for two reasons. It is read once per
block in an upward scan, so it wants to be a tag lookup and not a service call; and a pack that wants
a second abyssal fluid of its own should be able to have one without touching code.
Both halves are listed. The flowing one is nearly always transient -- deep water is placed as sources
by generation -- but a tongue of it running down a shaft somebody opened is still the deep, and it
should crush and darken while it lasts.
